revoked.note: https://docs.stripe.com/keys: a request without a valid key returns an invalid request error; https://docs.stripe.com/api/errors: 401; message prefix as matched by stripe/stripe-ios ServerErrorMapper.swift

error.message: The API key used for this request doesn't have the necessary permissions.

forbidden.note: https://docs.stripe.com/api/errors: 403; message is the problem statement at https://docs.stripe.com/error-handling#permission-errors; type: invalid_request_error is the only fitting value of the api_errors type enum in stripe/openapi spec3.json

error.message: Too many requests hit the API too quickly. We recommend an exponential backoff of your requests.

rateLimit.note: https://docs.stripe.com/rate-limits: 429 with Stripe-Rate-Limited-Reason; code and message from https://docs.stripe.com/error-codes; type per the stripe/openapi api_errors enum. Stripe documents no Retry-After; integration-mock adds one to every rate-limit answer
